description: This file declares functions, types, and structures related to SSDP (Simple Service Discovery Protocol) operations, including device discovery, device description, and IP address recovery.

methods.name: ssdpDiscoverStart
methods.description: Starts SSDP device discovery for a specified device type, invoking a callback upon device detection.

methods.name: ssdpDiscoverStop
methods.description: Stops an ongoing SSDP discovery process using the provided handle.

methods.name: ssdpRecoverIpAddress
methods.description: Attempts to locate a device by MAC address via SSDP to recover its current IP address.
